name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Stacks detergent bottles tightly, watching the street outside
thought: They keep talking in circles. Someone is pushing them to test me.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Scratches a note on the margin of the open folder
thought: Ruiz is watching every breath I take. I have to stay steady.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Wipes the glass of the display case with a greasy rag
thought: Everyone wants an angle today. Let them try.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Kicks a loose pebble across the empty concrete courtyard
thought: Dez thinks he owns every inch of this block. He doesn't.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: Holds the receiver tight to her ear, listening to the hum
thought: Chidi is talking too much about things he shouldn't know.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Adjusts the collar of his coat against the biting wind
thought: The timing has to be right before I make the next move.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Stirs the sludge in the mug, waiting for it to cool
thought: Kohl looks like he's going to throw up on the files.

name: Adaeze Okonkwo
action: Straightens the knitted throw over the back of the sofa
thought: Gus is avoiding me again. He thinks I won't wait.

name: Chidi Okonkwo
action: Flips the page of the folder, not really reading the words
thought: Nadia is staring right through me like I'm invisible.

speech.text: You don't have to keep looking at me like that, you know.

name: Ms. Priya Raman
action: Redates the stack of permission slips on the corner of the desk
thought: These kids think they are untouchable until the first letter arrives.

speech.text: Close the folder, Chidi. You aren't fooling anyone with those pages.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: Breathes on his cold knuckles, rubbing his hands together
thought: Amara is quiet today. Something is sitting heavy on her.

speech.text: You want me to lock up early if this freeze keeps up?

event: A car nobody recognises has been parked on the same corner for three days.

text: Gus Petrakis settles with Adaeze Okonkwo at The Blue Spoon. a favour they have never repaid, 4 days late.
action: Gus Petrakis settles with Adaeze Okonkwo at The Blue Spoon. a favour they have never repaid, 4 days late.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Signs the clipboard, dropping the pen on the counter.
thought: They keep asking about the ninth like I have answers.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Examines a tin of sardines, turning it in the light.
thought: Brady is sweating through his shirt again.

speech.text: You look like you're about to throw up, officer.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Fingers the strap of his duty belt, staring at a shelf.
thought: She likes watching me squirm while I'm off the clock.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Lines up pocket watches by size on the glass.
thought: Wes thinks he's clever bringing me half-broken junk.

speech.text: That's worth about half what you're asking, Doyle.

name: Junie Marsh
action: Wipes the laminate surface in slow, circular motions.
thought: Gus is staring at Adaeze like she's a ghost.

name: Adaeze Okonkwo
action: Rests her hands flat on the oilcloth table.
thought: Gus thinks he can stall me with fresh coffee.

speech.text: Four days late, Gus. I'm not moving till it's on this table.

name: Gus Petrakis
action: Stops with a rag in his hand, facing the booth.
thought: She has that look my grandmother used to give.

speech.text: It's coming together today, Adaeze. Just give me till the evening.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Kicks a loose pebble off the concrete ledge.
thought: Dez thinks he can lock me out and I'll just sit here.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Sloshes the lukewarm dregs at the bottom of her glass.
thought: Lyle thinks his pawnshop makes him untouchable.

speech.text: Drink up, kid. Fog's getting thicker.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: Traces the rim of her mug with one finger.
thought: Detective Ruiz smells like damp wool and bad coffee.

speech.text: It's not going to clear before dark.

name: Sticks
action: Pulls his wool coat tighter against the damp air.
thought: Marcus left his boots behind the radiator and nobody took them.

speech.text: Cold one coming off the water.
